hints.tr: Harfin sırası `ord(ch) - base`; `+ shift`, `% 26`, sonra `+ base` ve `chr`.
hints.en: The position is `ord(ch) - base`; `+ shift`, `% 26`, then `+ base` and `chr`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def caesar(text, shift):
    result = ""
    for ch in text:
        if ch.isalpha() and ch.isascii():
            base = ord("A") if ch.isupper() else ord("a")
            result += chr((ord(ch) - base + shift) % 26 + base)
        else:
            result += ch
    return result

print(caesar("Attack at dawn!", 3))
print(caesar("xyz", 3))
print(caesar("Dwwdfn", -3))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def caesar(text, shift):
    result = ""
    for ch in text:
        if ch.isalpha() and ch.isascii():
            base = ord("A") if ch.isupper() else ord("a")
            result += chr((ord(ch) - base + shift) % 26 + base)
        else:
            result += ch
    return result

print(caesar("Attack at dawn!", 3))
print(caesar("xyz", 3))
print(caesar("Dwwdfn", -3))
```
